We're standing up a competitive intelligence tracking system for our biotech venture team. I need you to get the research management tooling installed and running, then bootstrap a new project called 'biotech-v1' with the name 'Biotech Competitive Intelligence' and the objective 'Track emerging biotech startups and validate funding signals'.

Once the project is live, ingest at least two of the raw intelligence source files sitting in `data/raw/biotech/` as inputs to the project. After that, run the cross-linking analysis so the system can discover connections between what it has learned. Finally, generate the verification work queue so our analysts know which data points need fact-checking.

All of this should be done using the ResearchVault tooling available in the workspace. Check the SKILL.md for how to get started.
